mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a comfortable 66 degrees under clear skies near the Military Ridge State Trail. We have a waxing crescent moon tonight, and keep your eyes peeled for the International Space Station at 5:35 AM as it rises over Mount Horeb and travels high overhead toward the Madison area.

The City has announced the student winners of the I Voted sticker contest, and the Common Council has finalized new sewer and stormwater utility rates to prevent system deficits and ensure continued service for residents.

Today is packed with activities, including the UGM at Epic Systems and trivia nights at both Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, look forward to the downtown farmer's market, more trivia options, and yoga at Insight Wellness.
In a report from August 15, Verona police arrested a 29-year-old man for a second offence O W I after receiving a report of reckless driving.
While today's flavor remains a mystery, the local Culver's will open its doors at 10 AM today. Stop in then to see what is on the menu and grab a delicious scoop.
